prompt: Implement Grover's search algorithm on 3 qubits to find the single marked basis state |101>, using EXACTLY 2 Grover iterations (the optimal count for this problem size). Use a pure PHASE oracle with no ancilla qubit: it must flip the sign (apply a -1 phase) of |101> and leave every other basis state unchanged. Each iteration is (oracle; diffuser), where the diffuser is the standard 'inversion about the mean' operator 2|s><s| - I (s = uniform superposition) — any correct gate decomposition of the diffuser is acceptable, it does not have to match a specific textbook gate sequence, as long as it implements exactly that unitary. Start from Hadamard on all 3 qubits, then apply 2 iterations. Return the resulting 3-qubit state; no measurement.
